blurb: Guests rent boats equipped with Yamaha 4-stroke outboard engines for cruising on the Intracoastal waterway and adjoining navigable waters. Rental boats are not allowed in the ocean or for night operation. Operators receive a safety orientation and must be at least 21 years old with valid ID.
extraNote: 7 days cancellation policy; cancellations within 7 days charged 50%; within 48 hours charged 100% · Weather forecast does not warrant cancellation; if raining or thundering at rental time, free cancellation or reschedule · If rain or thunder begins during rental, prorated refund available · No ocean operation, no night operation, no towing · Open year-round
